input: piles contains n nonnegative safe integers with n<=100 and total S<=9007199254740991. Empty input is a zero-score extension. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. return: Maximum stones the first player can obtain when both play optimally.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Suffix sums and current-player scores lie in[0,S]. Opponent score is subtracted from all remaining stones, not from only the immediately taken piles. Index/limit arithmetic is bounded by3n. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n^3+1) time/O(n^2+1) auxiliary space including the padded DP table and suffix array. Descending index order completes every successor before use. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
